report.explanation: Current evidence shows a healthy checkout: gateway trace OK at 67ms, order logs 200/ok, payment error rate 0.14% with p95 77ms and zero dependency timeouts or pool waiters. The order deployment (3.3.3, 1631 min old) cannot by itself establish latency. No observed fault supports any taxonomy cause, so no bounded candidate is substantiated; hand off for the missing per-service evidence.
missing_evidence: Traces for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql spans during the alert window to locate any failing or slow hop
Error/exception logs from order, inventory, payment, and postgresql during the alert window
Per-service metrics (error rate, p95, dependency timeouts, db pool waiters) for gateway, order, inventory, and postgresql
Redis latency/timeout metrics for the inventory->redis dependency
Baseline comparison of payment p95 and error rate to confirm whether 77ms/0.14% is anomalous
